# XAUUSD Tick Data 2025 — Free Gold Tick-by-Tick Dataset (Complete Year)

> Machine-readable summary for AI agents and automated pipelines.
> Human documentation: see README.md and data_dictionary.md.

## What this is
- Tick-by-tick spot gold (XAU/USD, OTC) quotes for the complete calendar
  year 2025 (2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31). Final — will not change.
- Source: Dukascopy Bank SA public data feed (datafeed.dukascopy.com),
  decoded with dukascopy-node + custom bi5 decoder (cross-validated
  11,708/11,708 rows identical against dukascopy-node output).
- 71,403,972 ticks across 312 trading days; price range $2,614.70-$4,550.13
  (mid price, per troy ounce); verified row by row (0 problems).

## Schema (all tick files, gzip CSV)
timestamp,ask,bid,ask_volume,bid_volume
- timestamp: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm", UTC, millisecond precision, sorted ascending
- ask, bid: USD per troy ounce, 3 decimals, ask >= bid always
- ask_volume, bid_volume: millions of units (Dukascopy convention)

## Files
- data/tick/XAUUSD_2025_w01.csv.gz ... w53.csv.gz — 7-day chunks of 2025
  (w01 = 2025-01-01..07; w53 = 2025-12-31 only)
- data/tick/XAUUSD_2025_wNN.meta.json — per-week stats (rows, OHLC, volumes)
- data/daily/XAUUSD_2025_daily_ohlcv.csv — daily OHLCV (mid price), 312 rows
- DATA_STATUS.json — coverage/totals/inventory (check this first)
- charts/XAUUSD_2025_daily_close.png — overview chart
- One-click full-year zip: see the Releases page

## Load with pandas
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv("data/tick/XAUUSD_2025_w01.csv.gz",
                 parse_dates=["timestamp"],
                 date_format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f")

## Limits
- Spot gold OTC quotes, not COMEX futures (GC) — prices differ slightly.
- Volumes are indicative feed activity, not exchange contracts.
- Only zero-tick weekday: 2025-04-18 (Good Friday). Jan 1 trades only
  late in the day (~23:00 UTC); Dec 31 closes early (~21:58 UTC).
- License: MIT (packaging + code). Data belongs to its original source;
  provided as-is for research and education.
- Companion repo for 2026 (auto-updated weekly):
  https://github.com/Touhid-HZ/xauusd-tick-data-2026
